definitions.explicit_action_rel: ||y_gpu - A_cpu x|| / ||A_cpu x|| on the free DOFs, A_cpu the independent CPU assembly
definitions.dot_rel: |<y, A x> - <A^T y, x>| / (||y|| ||A x||), A x and A^T y both from the GPU actions
definitions.matrix_max_rel: max |G - A_cpu| / max |A_cpu| over the free-DOF matrix, G from the GPU action on every unit vector
definitions.ordinary_vectors: three uniform random fields in [-1, 1] and one smooth field, zero on the clamped DOFs

coefficient_emulation.orders_identified_on: s22 (kernel coefficients read from the forward basis columns)

held_out_total.note: the orders were identified on s22; asym also served the independent cross-identification of the orders (orders_from_asym_identical) and is counted here as held out from s22

s22_gate.note: the stencil columns are compared bit for bit and sym_err exactly; the derived eigensolver figures (lambda_min, the eigenvalue errors) under 1 % relative, the task's eigenvalue tolerance, since LAPACK's thread order changes them at about 1e-6 relative (operator's correction of 2026-11-24); the atomic FP32 element kernels are not bitwise reproducible run to run, so only their negative count (the Table S22 conclusion) enters the gate; their other metrics are reported with the run-to-run spread in s22_reproduction.json
